_about.what: Forum selection, deadlines and fees, as data the code evaluates.
_about.why: These are the answers a model is most confidently wrong about: it will invent a pecuniary limit, miscount a limitation period, or quote a filing fee from another country. None of it is generated. The code reads this file, does the arithmetic on real dates, and the model is only allowed to narrate the result.

consumer.label: 2 years
consumer.runs_from: the date the cause of action arose, usually the date of refusal or the date the service failed
consumer.condonation_note: The commission may admit a late complaint if you show sufficient cause and it records reasons.

salary_pwa.label: 12 months
salary_pwa.runs_from: the date the wages became payable or the deduction was made
salary_pwa.condonation_note: The Authority may admit a late application for sufficient cause, but do not rely on it.

salary_civil.label: 3 years
salary_civil.runs_from: the date the amount fell due and was not paid
salary_civil.condonation_note: A civil suit filed out of time is liable to be dismissed as time-barred, and the court applies the bar by itself.

deposit.label: 3 years
deposit.runs_from: the date the landlord refused to refund, or the date the deposit became payable on handing over possession
deposit.condonation_note: A civil suit filed out of time is liable to be dismissed as time-barred, and the court applies the bar by itself.

consumer.name: National Consumer Helpline (1915)
consumer.how: Call 1915 or file at consumerhelpline.gov.in. They take it up with the company directly.

consumer.name: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
consumer.typical_time: 3 months is the statutory target; in practice often longer
consumer.how: File online yourself at edaakhil.nic.in, or in person at the District Commission for the district where you live or work.

consumer.name: State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
consumer.how: File at the State Commission for your state, or online at edaakhil.nic.in.

consumer.name: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
consumer.how: File at the National Commission, New Delhi, or online at edaakhil.nic.in.

salary.name: Written demand to the employer
salary.cost: Free, or the cost of registered post
salary.how: Email HR and the reporting manager with the exact amount and period, and ask for a written reason if they refuse. Keep the thread.

salary.name: Authority under the Payment of Wages Act
salary.cost: No court fee for the application
salary.typical_time: varies by state, often a few months
salary.how: Apply to the Authority appointed under the Payment of Wages Act for your area, through the state Labour Department or Labour Commissioner's office.

salary.name: Labour Commissioner / conciliation
salary.how: File a complaint with the office of the Labour Commissioner for your district. They call both sides for conciliation.

salary.name: Labour Court, for computation and recovery
salary.how: Apply to the Labour Court under section 33C(2) of the Industrial Disputes Act for the amount due to be computed and certified for recovery.
salary.caveat: Open only to those who qualify as a 'workman', which excludes most managerial and supervisory roles. Get this checked.

salary.name: Civil suit for recovery
salary.cost: Court fee on a percentage of the amount claimed, varying by state
salary.how: A recovery suit in the civil court with jurisdiction. Usually the last resort for salary.

deposit.name: Written demand to the landlord
deposit.cost: Free, or the cost of registered post
deposit.how: Message or email the landlord with the amount, the date you vacated and a deadline. Get the refusal in writing if you can; it is the most useful document you will have.

deposit.name: Legal notice
deposit.cost: Free if you send it yourself; a lawyer typically charges a modest fee
deposit.how: Send by registered post with acknowledgement due, and keep the receipt and the tracking record.

deposit.name: Rent Controller or Rent Tribunal under your state's rent law
deposit.how: Check whether your state's Rent Act gives a Rent Controller jurisdiction over deposit disputes. The District Legal Services Authority can tell you for free.
deposit.caveat: Whether this route exists at all depends entirely on your state.

deposit.name: Court of Small Causes
deposit.cost: Court fee on the amount claimed; lower than a regular suit
deposit.how: A summary money recovery suit, where your state's small causes ceiling covers the amount.

deposit.name: Civil suit for recovery of money
deposit.cost: Court fee on a percentage of the amount claimed, varying by state
deposit.how: A recovery suit in the civil court with jurisdiction over the property or the landlord's residence.

escalate_to_human._about: Conditions under which the assistant must stop advising and send the user to a real lawyer. Evaluated in code, never left to the model's judgement.
